location_multipliers.methodology: multiplier = RPP_goods(target) / RPP_goods(Augusta GA metro). Multiply any price in this dataset by the multiplier to estimate the equivalent local shelf price. RPPs are indexed to US average = 100; the Goods component is the closest official proxy for grocery price levels. Base is the metro-level Goods RPP for the Augusta-Richmond County, GA-SC MSA (96.293, 2024). All rpp_goods values are official BEA 2024 estimates.
